products.seoDescription: Shop genuine hematite bracelet for men. Natural stone, hardened steel level hardness, no clasp design. Buy 1 Get 1 Free, $34.98. Free shipping, 30-day returns.
products.descriptionHtml:
Reclaim Your Edge Confidence Natural Hematite Stone Beaded Stretch Healing Bracelets Gift Jewelry

Polished hematite beads on a stretch elastic core, no clasp, no hardware, nothing to break. Metallic gunmetal-black, dense enough to notice the moment you pick it up.

Hematite is an iron oxide, one of the most abundant iron ores on Earth, cut and polished here for jewellery rather than industrial use. That iron content is what gives every bead its weight: pick the bracelet up and it sits heavier in the hand than its size suggests, and under the black polish it streaks red-brown when scratched, the same test a mineralogist would use to confirm the real stone rather than dyed glass or resin.

At 5.5-6.5 on the Mohs scale, it's roughly as hard as hardened steel, hard enough to take daily knocks against a desk, a doorframe or a dumbbell without dulling, and hard enough that the hand-polished gunmetal finish stays a finish, not a coating that wears through. There's no plating to chip and no coating over the stone: what you see the day it arrives is what you'll still see years in.

The build is as low-maintenance as the material: a single stretch elastic core threaded through the beads, no clasp and no sizing chart. Roll it over your hand and forget it's there, it fits a range of wrist sizes without ever needing adjustment, and there's no clasp mechanism to eventually fail.

  • Genuine stone, not imitation: real hematite (iron oxide), verifiable by its red-brown streak, not resin or dyed glass standing in for it.
  • Built to take daily wear: 5.5-6.5 Mohs hardness holds up to knocks, desks and gym bags without dulling the polish.
  • No clasp to break: one stretch elastic core, on in one motion, nothing to fasten or eventually snap.
  • Fits without sizing: the elastic core stretches across a wide range of wrist sizes, so there's no chart to check before you order.
  • Substantial by design: 70g of dense, iron-rich stone on a single strand, present enough to feel deliberate under a cuff.
  • Finish that lasts: hand-polished directly on the stone, with no plating or coating to wear through over time.
  • Pairs with anything black or steel-toned: the gunmetal shine reads as understated metal, so it layers cleanly with a watch or a second bracelet without competing for attention.

We describe hematite for what it verifiably is composition, hardness, the streak test, not what it will do for you beyond that. No health claims, just a genuine stone built into a bracelet that's easy to wear every day and hard to wear out.

products.subtitle: Magnetic or non-magnetic · sizes 6–10
products.descriptionHtml: A curved hematite band in two finishes: natural non-magnetic hematite, or a man-made magnetic hematite (often called "hematine") for the magnetic variants. Natural hematite itself is only weakly magnetic — the strongly magnetic feel in the "Magnetic" sizes comes from that man-made version, same as most magnetic hematite jewellery on the market. We would rather tell you that than let you assume otherwise.

products.descriptionHtml:
SPECIFICATIONS

Arm Exerciser Grade: 22-440lb

Brand Name: MERACH

Display: LCD Rep Counter / Digital Counter Display

Foldable: Yes / Snap-Lock Folding Design

Function: ARMS

Handle: Ergonomic PU Handle / Non-Slip Grip

High-concerned chemical: none

Material: High-Density Carbon Steel / Double-Layer Steel

Model Number: 2520

Origin: Mainland China

Product Type: Hydraulic Arm Exerciser / Chest Exercise Machine / Arm Strength Trainer

Resistance Levels: 20 Adjustable Levels

Resistance Range: max 440 lbs

Resistance Type: Hydraulic Resistance / Adjustable Hydraulic

Structure: Triangular Reinforced Structure

Target Area: Chest / Arms / Shoulders / Forearms / Upper Body

Training Site: Waist,ARMS,Waist & Abdomen Exercise,Hand,Wrist,Hip,Chest,Core

Type: Hydraulic arm

Type of sports: Strength Training


Adjustable Resistance 22–440 lbs + LCD Rep Counter – One Machine for Every Level

This hydraulic arm exerciser features 20 adjustable resistance levels (22–440 lbs) with a simple twist-knob design—no tools needed. Whether you're a beginner building foundational strength or an advanced athlete pushing limits, dial in the exact resistance you need. The built-in LCD counter tracks every rep in real time, so you can set goals, monitor progress, and stay motivated without guesswork. Perfect replacement for multiple dumbbells or resistance bands.

Upgraded Safety Design – Protect Your Hands & Equipment

Unlike traditional arm trainers, the Merach hydraulic chest exerciser adds a reinforced protective housing around the hydraulic cylinder and strength gauge. This cushions accidental impacts, prevents oil leakage, and significantly reduces the risk of pinch injuries. The safe micro-rebound mechanism ensures smooth, controlled resistance—no sudden snap-back. Train with confidence at home, in the gym, or anywhere.

Industrial-Grade Durability – Built to Last Years of Heavy Use

Constructed with double-layer high-density carbon steel that resists deformation and breakage even under maximum load. The core hydraulic cylinder is fully sealed for consistent, stable resistance throughout every rep—no fading, no jerking. Combined with a reinforced triangular structure and heavy-duty rivets, this chest workout equipment delivers rock-solid stability during intense training sessions.

Ergonomic & Portable – Train Anywhere, Store Anywhere

Designed with wear-resistant, non-slip PU ergonomic handles for a comfortable grip during high-rep sets—no blisters, no slipping. The bottom snap-lock mechanism allows instant folding for compact storage under a bed, in a closet, or in a gym bag. Lightweight enough to carry to the office, park, or while traveling. Your full upper-body workout is always within arm's reach.

Full Upper-Body Training for Men & Women – Home Gym Essential

Targets chest, arms, shoulders, forearms, and back in one compact tool. Ideal for men building muscle mass, women toning arms, seniors maintaining joint mobility, and athletes recovering from injury. Replaces bulky gym machines with a space-saving solution perfect for apartments, dorm rooms, home gyms, or office breaks. Backed by Merach's comprehensive after-sales support—contact us anytime for assistance.


Note

1. Ships from Local warehouse. Fast shipping. Free shipping.
2. Please allow 1-2 cm error in size due to different manual measurement methods.
3. PO box addresses cannot be used for shipping; please do not leave a PO box address.
4.Tracking information will usually be updated in 24- 72 hours.

RELIABLE AFTER-SALES SUPPORT

Your purchase comes with a 1-year warranty covering all covered faults. We will provide replacement parts free of charge to ensure long-term use without the hassle of returning bulky equipment. Within one year, for products that are irreparable or completely unusable, we will provide a free replacement. We also offer a standard 30-day return policy.

Friendly reminder: Due to different global time zones, please allow us a maximum of 24 hours to respond to your messages. If you need assistance, please contact us directly before initiating a dispute—we are always ready to help!

specs.label: Resistance range
specs.description: Twenty resistance levels, dialled in with a simple twist knob and no tools. Start light on day one, then keep turning it up. One compact trainer stands in for a whole rack of bands and dumbbells.

specs.label: Rep counter
specs.description: The built-in LCD counts each rep in real time, so you can chase a number instead of losing track mid-set. Pick a target, beat it, and watch it climb session after session.

specs.label: Frame
specs.description: High-density carbon steel with a reinforced triangular structure and heavy-duty rivets, so it holds its shape at full load, rep after rep. Compact at 16.7 × 6.4 in.

specs.label: Handles
specs.description: Wear-resistant PU handles shaped for your hand, with a textured grip that stays put through the longest sets. Choose black, blue or red to match your gym.

specs.label: Muscles worked
specs.description: Press, pull and squeeze from the same frame and train your whole upper body with one tool, in a corner of the room instead of a corner of the gym.

features.label: Hydraulic power, safely housed
features.body: The cylinder and strength gauge sit inside a reinforced housing, so knocks stay off the working parts and the oil stays sealed in. A smooth micro-rebound brings the arms back under control, never snapping.

features.label: A triangle that keeps every rep honest
features.body: The triangular frame locks each rep onto the same arc. No wobble and no wandering, just a stable, repeatable press from the first rep to the fiftieth.

features.label: Folds away in seconds
features.body: One snap-lock at the base and it folds flat. Slide it under the bed, into a closet or into a gym bag, so a full upper-body session goes wherever you do.
